title: S38 — Cross-validation: run full bench on seed-2 suite (verify generalization)
desc: All measurements so far are on seed-1 suite. Need to verify results generalize to independent data. Method: (1) generate seed-2 suite (same families, different RNG seed); (2) run full bench with current shipping route (reader_lex); (3) compare easy/hard% to seed-1; (4) if seed-2 within ±2% of seed-1, results are stable; if gap > 5%, investigate seed-dependent bugs.
